title: Wording for the water shut-off notice (test fixture)
question: Which wording should the notice at the top of the ledger use?

recommended.reason: it gives the day and the hours in the heading, which is what a plot holder needs first.

options.name: What and when
options.note: Puts the day and the hours in the heading; the longest heading of the three.

sample.heading: Water off on Saturday, 8 am to noon
sample.sub: The mains pipe by the north gate is being replaced. Fill your butts on Friday.

options.name: What to do
options.note: Leads with the action a plot holder should take; the dates move to the second line.

sample.heading: Fill your water butts by Friday
sample.sub: The water will be off on Saturday from 8 am to noon while the north gate pipe is replaced.

options.name: Short label
options.note: A two word heading with everything else below it; the quickest to skim and the easiest to ignore.

sample.heading: Water shut-off
sample.sub: Saturday, 8 am to noon. The mains pipe by the north gate is being replaced.
